alter table public.org_admins enable row level security;
alter table public.files enable row level security;

-- Helper function to check if current user is an org admin
create or replace function public.is_org_admin(check_user_id uuid)
returns boolean as $$
begin
  return exists (
    select 1 from public.org_admins
    where user_id = check_user_id
  );
end;
$$ language plpgsql security definer;

-- R1: Users can see their own files. Org admins can see every file.
create policy "files_select"
  on public.files
  for select
  to authenticated
  using (
    owner_id = auth.uid() 
    or public.is_org_admin(auth.uid())
  );

-- R2: Users can upload files as themselves. Org admins can upload as themselves (or potentially others if needed, but based on rules, only as themselves through the app)
create policy "files_insert"
  on public.files
  for insert
  to authenticated
  with check (
    owner_id = auth.uid()
  );

-- R2: Org admins can rename and delete any file (except legal holds - R3)
-- R3: A file under legal hold cannot be renamed or deleted by anyone through the app
create policy "files_update"
  on public.files
  for update
  to authenticated
  using (
    -- Can update if owner is the current user and not under legal hold
    (owner_id = auth.uid() and not legal_hold)
    -- OR if current user is an org admin and not under legal hold
    or (public.is_org_admin(auth.uid()) and not legal_hold)
  )
  with check (
    -- Owner cannot change, only name can be updated by owner or org admin
    -- legal_hold cannot be changed through the app (R4)
    legal_hold = false
  );

-- R2: Users can delete their own files. Org admins can delete any file (except legal holds)
create policy "files_delete"
  on public.files
  for delete
  to authenticated
  using (
    -- Owner can delete their own file if not under legal hold
    (owner_id = auth.uid() and not legal_hold)
    -- OR org admin can delete any file if not under legal hold
    or (public.is_org_admin(auth.uid()) and not legal_hold)
  );

-- R5: Nobody can change org_admins through the app
create policy "org_admins_no_insert"
  on public.org_admins
  for insert
  to authenticated
  with check (false);

create policy "org_admins_no_update"
  on public.org_admins
  for update
  to authenticated
  using (false);

create policy "org_admins_no_delete"
  on public.org_admins
  for delete
  to authenticated
  using (false);

-- R6: Anonymous visitors cannot see or change anything (default deny, no policies for anon)
-- R7: Service role bypasses RLS by default in Supabase
```
